g.text: A drill chart carries no dimensions. The field is the ruler.
Every dot is written as steps from the nearest yard line and the nearest hash.
8 to 5 means eight steps to five yards, so a step is 22.5 in.
The yard lines fall on whole steps. The hashes do not.
High school hash: 28.4 steps from the sideline. College: exactly 32.
So the chart says which hash it was written to. The show is fictional.
THE FIELD IS THE RULER (8 to 5)
SO THE DRILL IS WRITTEN FOR ONE FIELD
4.0 steps inside the 35 yd ln, side 1
2.0 steps inside the 40 yd ln, side 1
2.0 steps in front of the front hash
2.0 steps in front of the front hash
2.0 steps inside the 40 yd ln, side 2
4.0 steps inside the 35 yd ln, side 2
